context: Resume tailoring upgrade: AI bullet reframing with factual validation, zero-omission forensics

context_transition.trigger_for_switch: Owner feared newer tailored resumes were shortened and demanded the mechanism plus a fix honoring brain-thinks/actuator-verifies split
context_transition.new_context: Tailoring forensics, reframe implementation, docs versioning

user_intent: Owner wants AI (not Python) to analyze the JD and diplomatically reframe company bullets with ATS terms after deep thinking — with guarantees that nothing is skipped and no new tech is added that could fail interviews
why_user_made_such_thinking: Owner holds the plan as contract: scripts must not think, brains must. Reorder-only tailoring felt thin for ATS pickup, but any AI rewriting without guardrails risks hallucinated stacks.
why_user_performed_this_way: Presents the design as recalled agreement plus hard constraints (nothing skipped, interview-safe), delegating mechanism design while holding veto on results.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Demanded forensic proof of omission first, then the ordered feature with validation, docs, and verification — accepted staged delivery with live proof at each gate.
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes — diffed artifacts before theorizing (63/63 ended the debate), implemented brain-proposes/Python-disposes with per-role atomic fallback, and caught a real marker-stripping defect live via the new guardrail.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes — reframe pass ordered ON by default, validation enforces count/numbers/tech-allowlist, offline mode skips silently, docs versioned, gates green.
evolutionary_takeaways: 1) Diff before diagnosing quality drift — impressions of shortening were reorder perception, proven in one script. 2) New AI output channels need same-output-shape validators (count, markers) or formatting silently degrades. 3) Residual gaps (common-shaped tech words) get tripwire logging, not false-reject rules.
